Class SettingsScreen

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent

javafx.scene.layout.Pane

gui.screens.SettingsScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class SettingsScreen extends javafx.scene.layout.StackPane
A JavaFX UI component representing the Settings and Pause menu.

This class extends StackPane and provides global volume controls (Master, Music, SFX) via sliders. It is designed to be versatile: it can be opened from the main menu or as an overlay during gameplay. When opened during gameplay, it acts as a pause menu and provides an option to quit the game.

  • Constructor Details

    • SettingsScreen

      public SettingsScreen(Runnable onClose, Runnable onQuit)
      Constructs a new SettingsScreen with specific close and quit behaviors.

      Initializes the layout, dynamically builds the volume sliders bound to the SoundManager, and triggers an entrance animation (fade and scale).

      Parameters:
      onClose - A Runnable executed when the user saves and closes the menu.
      onQuit - A Runnable executed when the user clicks the "Quit Game" button. If this is null, the screen assumes it is not in-game and hides the quit button.
